services.desc: You are part of the Gale family in Kansas, you find yourself trapped inside of your auntie's home with a tornado on the horizon. You bump your head and wake up not knowing where you are and what you're going to do next, but no one else is around the house. One things for sure... You're not in Kansas anymore! So follow the Yellow Brick Road, find the keys to the Emerald City and get yourself back because there's no place like home! Aliester Hawthorne, known and revered explorer has gone missing on his quest to find the magic lamp.
